concept: SNS + SQS fan-out: one event to many queues
tests: Which service publishes events for asynchronous fan-out to many independent consumers.
expected: An SNS topic with multiple subscriptions (SQS queues, Lambda): every message is delivered to every subscriber. Triggers: "fan-out", "one event notifies multiple independent consumers", "asynchronous".
why_not: A single SQS queue hands a message to one consumer; direct Lambda-to-Lambda calls couple functions; EBS is block storage.
